route: Temporary Work Permit (up to 4 months); Exemption Work Permit (up to 1 month)

permit.applies: The employer, to the Department of Labour and Employment Services.

fees.what: Temporary Work Permit (employment up to 4 months), total
Exemption Work Permit (employment not exceeding 1 month), total

sources.title: Department of Labour and Employment Services (Vanuatu), Directive on the Implementation of Fees for Temporary and Exemption Work Permits (20 June 2025)
sources.said: any employer who wish to employ a non-citizen worker for up to 4 months must apply for a Temporary Work Permit and pay the total fee of VT 60,000 to the Department of Labour. Similarly, for employment not exceeding 1 month, an Exemption Work Permit must be applied for, with a total fee of VT 30,000.
